about:
Get a glimpse of Canvas Paris Ivry, your future home just minutes from Paris city center! This brand-new student residence is ideally located in a top student area and is more than just housing, it’s a vibrant student community designed for success, comfort, and social life.
Enjoy fully furnished studios with all-inclusive rent (water, heating, electricity, high-speed internet), plus access to outstanding amenities, a rooftop with stunning views of Paris, and a dedicated on-site team ready to make your student life unforgettable. While the building is being finished, you can explore our 3D model and enjoy sneak peeks of the residence.
